instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.llm: On the title screen, open Settings, then LLMs, and fill in the Main LLM: its base URL, key and model. It writes every scene, and in the editor it drafts characters and majors. A reply of 1024 tokens or more is best; a reasoning model needs more. The NSFW LLM is optional.
instructions.comfy: Pictures are drawn on your own ComfyUI. In Settings, ComfyUI, give its address, test it, and download the models the game's workflows call for. Here, the ComfyUI side sets the size, framing and prompts of each kind of picture. You can skip this and upload pictures of your own instead.
instructions.major: A student reads one of the game's subjects, or one you make. On the Majors side, Draft with AI writes a subject, its courses, their topics and questions, and the skill each teaches. Read it over, change what you like, and save it before you make the character who studies it.
instructions.character: On the Characters side, New character starts her from a few words, from a SillyTavern card, or from nothing. Then:
instructions.profile: Profile: read everything over, and set her kind (student, teacher, outsider or NPC), age, birthday and secrets.
instructions.academics: Academics: what she studies, or the courses she teaches.
instructions.media: Media: generate the faces of each outfit, cut out their backgrounds, then her NSFW pictures, their clips, her walking picture and her room's pictures. Optimize turns them into smaller files.
instructions.save: Save. Saving checks the whole game still loads with her, and says what to fix if not.
instructions.courses: Saving a character or a major builds the term's schedule again by itself. On the Courses side, check that she has her four courses, and build it again if the title screen says the catalogue is out of date.
instructions.newGame: A new character has her classes from the next new game on. A game already under way will have her in it, but not in any class. Everything you make is kept in the add-on folder (Open the add-on folder, on the Characters side); back it up before you change it a great deal.
